name: 作業と工数を揃える表行
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Generate ONE static Lighthouse Japanese task table row LH09-0027「作業と工数を揃える表行」. Original images1–2 control every icon silhouette, thin stroke, optical size, alignment, column geometry, fine detail and visible state. Image3 is secondary Japanese wording only; restore what it omitted.
A compact white row, 1188x36 logical pixels, seven columns with widths 522,114,114,132,114,113,80. Fine neutral horizontal/vertical cell rules, pure #FFFFFF page/cells, no gray/mint panels, no raised cards, no extra table header or task rows. Tight framing, all seven columns visible.
In first cell, original order and spacing: small filled right-facing disclosure triangle, thin outlined circular completion check button, title「礼拝の資料を準備する」in Meiryo Regular14/24 black, then small metadata「1」and original small thumbs-up silhouette (the like-count state; muted source blue allowed), then「2」and the original tiny dependency/relationship glyph with connected small nodes. Use exact source glyph geometry, not arbitrary substitute icons, no emoji.
Second cell: source-sized circular avatar containing Japanese initial「山」, then「山田 花子」in Regular12/16. Avatar white with fine neutral border and slate text, matching official ordinary white surfaces. Third cell MUST show the original empty-date action: tiny calendar enclosed in a dashed circular boundary, no date text. The mock's 4月15日 is not the original visible state, so omit that date. Remaining four cells are empty, preserving the original state.
All supporting neutral icons #526173. Preserve source icon enclosures, proportions, stroke and baselines. Meiryo regular text, zero tracking; no bold. Japanese only apart from numeric counters. This is a clean flat crisp UI strip, no branding, watermark, perspective, phone/desktop shell, annotations, comparison grid, or additional content.
reviewNotes: 初回出力を目視。円内チェック欠落、いいね後の余分な1、担当者と期日の区切り欠落を確認。7列と元アイコン状態の修正が必要。元画像を保持し訂正予定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Chromeで観察した公開画像URLまたは文書化された画像保存
